results.title: Ishan Kishan Tells Vaibhav Sooryavanshi to Ignore Social Media Ahead of IND vs ZIM 3rd T20I
results.description: India vs Zimbabwe: Ishan Kishan revealed the advice given to teenage sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi after his maiden T20I fifty. The India wicketkeeper urged the 15-year-old to focus on cricket, ignore social media distractions, and continue enjoying his game.
